representation.rationale: Building on the best prior result (resnet18 at 0.9908 with depth=3, hidden=32), this candidate increases capacity modestly (depth 3→4, hidden 32→48) to capture finer multi-scale pathology features while staying well within the 90K-sample training budget. The lower learning rate (3e-4 vs 5e-4) compensates for the additional depth, reducing the risk of training instability. Class weighting is enabled to explicitly address the 1.63× imbalance (classes 5 and 8 have ~7.9K samples vs 12.9K for class 8), which the prior best result did not use. Adding rotate180 to the hflip+vflip augmentation set provides geometric diversity without destroying tissue-orientation cues (unlike arbitrary rotations). The cosine scheduler and adamw optimizer with weight_decay=1e-4 are retained from the proven configuration. Early stopping patience of 5 allows the model to converge past the epoch-3 plateau seen in prior runs. Total parameters remain in the 2-4M range, appropriate for 90K samples.

payload.selection_rule: highest epoch budget, then accuracy within tolerance, then macro-F1; test locked
